title: Synchronized Logit Steering: Real-world Steganography
abstract: arXiv:2608.14697v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Steganography in large language models offers a way to embed hidden messages within natural-sounding text. Existing token and logit-level methods typically require the sender and receiver to share an identical prompt context, which is rarely guaranteed in production pipelines that use retrieval-augmented generation or proprietary system instructions. We introduce Synchronized Logit Steering (SLS), a deterministic steganographic scheme that eliminates this dependency by deriving a proxy prompt from the generated output itself, allowing both parties to reconstruct the same logit distribution without access to the original prompt. SLS encodes payload values as token ranks within high-entropy regions of the proxy prompt distribution, and we extend the scheme with periodic recurrence and payload bursts to scale information density. translated_title: 同步逻辑引导：现实世界中的隐写术
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14697v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型中的隐写术提供了一种在自然文本中嵌入隐藏消息的方法。现有的基于令牌和逻辑级别的方法通常要求发送方和接收方共享相同的提示上下文，但在使用检索增强生成或专有系统指令的生产环境中，这很少能得到保证。我们引入了同步逻辑引导（SLS），一种确定性隐写方案，通过从生成的输出本身推导出代理提示来消除这种依赖，使双方无需访问原始提示即可重建相同的逻辑分布。SLS将载荷值编码为代理提示分布中高熵区域内的令牌排名，并通过周期性重复和载荷突发来扩展信息密度。在ShareGPT、GSM8K和SWE-bench Verified上，我们展示了真实提示与代理提示之间的KL散度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为同步逻辑引导（SLS）的隐写方法，通过从输出中生成代理提示，无需共享原始提示即可实现可靠的消息嵌入，提高了实际生产环境中的可用性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Synchronized Logit Steering (SLS), a steganographic method that derives a proxy prompt from the output to eliminate the need for shared prompts, enhancing practicality in real-world settings.
